claims.harm: parallelization could degrade rescan performance on non-SSD disks due to random I/O seeking
claims.quote: Have you benchmarked this on a non-SSD?
claims.settled_by_quote: I have measured it on an Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-7700 CPU with 8 cores, 64Gi RAM and a HDD

claims.harm: scanning thread competing for mutexes and tasks could starve workers and slow down rescanning
claims.quote: All workers already process submit task in its own WorkThread just randomly trying to acquire mutex from scanning thread is non sense to me.
claims.settled_by_quote: I have changed the implementation so that the main thread only joins task processing when it needs to clear the work queue

claims.harm: mixing scanning restructuring with parallelization overcomplicates review and combines distinct responsibilities
claims.quote: I think it would be nice to first improve the current scanning code structure, then land the parallelization feature.
claims.settled_by_quote: I moved the test change into https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/34667 and the ScanForWalletTransactions refactor into https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/34681.

claims.harm: sharing a global threadpool across wallets could let a rescan controller thread process tasks from another wallet's RPC, distorting latency
claims.quote: Can't it happen that this controller thread picks up the task of another RPC of another wallet, thereby distorting results (from a RPC latency point of view) of this one?
claims.settled_by_quote: I have moved away from a shared ThreadPool to one that is initialized before scanning and discarded after.

support.reason: Speedup scales well up to 16 threads, going from ~283s down to ~63s — a 4.5x improvement.
verified benchmarks on HDD setup demonstrating a 3x speedup
re-ran benchmarks with updated changes showing 6x speedup relative to master
Strong Concept ACK ae888e0, forgot to share it in the prior review.

result.notes: Initial assessment populated. All concerns regarding non-SSD performance, prerequisite refactoring, and thread pool sharing have been addressed and resolved.
